subject: Leadership roundup: stability signals, renewal friction points, and top-spot asks
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Leadership roundup: stability signals, renewal friction points, and top-spot asks

Team —

As we close Q2 and finalize the Q3 QBR packet for the board, I need a short, actionable snapshot on accounts with renewals in the next 90 days and any items that require exec attention. No long writeups — stick to the checklist below and send back by EOD Monday (7/12):

- Account (name) — one-line health (green/amber/red)
- Days until renewal / committed contract date
- Primary friction: (ops / pricing / security / compliance / adoption) — one line
- Recommended immediate ask (e.g., credit, architecture review, legal support, exec outreach)
- Attach link or filename to the latest health snapshot / MAP

I'm attaching the current health snapshot for BrightWorks and the Stratus MAP I pulled last week — use them as the source of truth and add any updates.

Attachments: brightworks_health_snapshot_2027-07-10.xlsx, mutual_action_plan_stratus_v2.docx

Thanks — this will feed the executive attention slide and the renewal-risk register.

Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Customer Strategy | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership roundup: stability signals, renewal friction points, and top-spot asks

Mina — quick updates (per your checklist):

- BrightWorks — amber. Renewal in 48 days (2027-08-28). Friction: procurement & SSO scoping (security). Recommended ask: legal to sign comms + offer 60-day limited credit to buy time for SSO delivery. Attached the latest health tab.
  Attachment: brightworks_health_snapshot_2027-07-10.xlsx (see comments on procurement timeline)

- Apex Retail — green. Renewal in 72 days. Friction: none material, adoption trending up. Recommend standard renewal cadence; no exec required.

- TidalApps — red. Renewal in 21 days. Friction: performance spikes tied to 8k context windows; has open critical SRs. Recommend immediate architecture review with runtime team and a prep call with customer CSM + SE.

I'll add short notes to the Drive folder you linked.

Laura Bennett
Senior Renewals Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Date: 2027-07-12T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership roundup: stability signals, renewal friction points, and top-spot asks

Mina / team — adding one escalation candidate and a note on expected run-rate for Dedicated seats:

- Stratus Analytics — amber->red risk. Renewal in 34 days (2027-08-14). Friction: they reported repeated instability on p95 latency during nightly ingest; procurement has flagged additional SOC evidence requests. Customer is asking for a written remediation plan and potential credit if SLA breaches continue.
  Recommended ask: schedule an exec sync (CS + Product + Ops) to present remediation + approve a one-time service credit if we miss the next SLA window. Also flag legal to expedite the SOC addendum.
  Attachment: stratus_arch_review_notes.pdf; mutual_action_plan_stratus_v2.docx

- On the Dedicated run-rate: we expect an uptick as two mid-market accounts convert to reserved capacity by Sept; I'll send a separate note to ops with forecast numbers.

I'll join the call with Stratus if we get a slot.

Marcus Lin
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Heather G. <heather@brightworks.com>
Date: 2027-07-13T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Leadership roundup: stability signals, renewal friction points, and top-spot asks — consolidated

Team / Jonas — thanks for the quick turns. Consolidated ask list below for exec attention and QBR slides. I'm sending a short heads-up to BrightWorks (Heather CC'd) so execs have line of sight.

Summary (accounts flagged for exec attention):
- BrightWorks — amber. Renewal 2027-08-28. Ask: legal + procurement support to close SSO scoping; offer 60-day limited credit if procurement timeline slips. Owner: Laura.
- Stratus Analytics — high-risk. Renewal 2027-08-14. Ask: schedule 30-min exec sync this week (CS + Product + Ops) to present remediation plan; pre-approve up to 5% one-time credit if SLA breached. Owner: Marcus.
- TidalApps — red. Renewal 2027-08-01. Ask: runtime architecture deep-dive + prioritized engineering triage. Owner: Laura + Ops.

Action items (short):
1) Jonas: please draft the two exec slide bullets (BrightWorks / Stratus) for the board deck; include one-line ask and recommended owner. Due: EOD 7/14.
2) Laura: confirm procurement/contract milestones for BrightWorks and share current redlines in HubSpot (HS-78234).
3) Marcus: book the Stratus remediation sync and loop in Product/Infra; bring the stratus_arch_review_notes.pdf to the meeting.
4) Irene: confirm whether SOC addendum can be turned around within two weeks (legal/KMS path).

External outreach: Heather — thanks for taking this; we'll follow up with a time proposal for an exec sync and a short remediation plan. If you want the MAP before we meet, it's attached.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_stratus_v2.docx, stratus_arch_review_notes.pdf

I'll fold the owners' one-liners into the QBR packet and circulate by EOD 7/15.

Mina Haddad
Head of Customer Strategy | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
